jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
🚀 Join Our Product DevOps Team as a Sr. Developer! 🚀

Are you a skilled developer looking for a dynamic and challenging opportunity? Join our passionate product dev(ops) team, where you'll be an integral part of the end-to-end development, bug fixing, and delivery to production process.

🔧 What You'll Do:
• Contribute to the technical roadmap, shaping the future of our product.
• Implement product vision
• Work in an agile environment (derived from SAFe), ensuring efficient development and delivery processes.
• Contribute to development and quality processes
• As a member of the team responsible for the module, you will enjoy full autonomy to deploy your code into production
• Growth: Learn from the best in the industry, with access to formal training and certifications.
• Coach junior developers
• Review the code and approve the Pull Requests
• Embrace a collaborative DevOps culture, participating in rotating on-call shifts.

🛠️ Tech Stack:
• Language: Java
• Frameworks: Spring... Hibernate
• Cloud: AWS (Amazon Web Services)
• CI/CD: Custom In-House Pipeline on AWS tools and services
• IaC: Terraform
• Code Repo: Bitbucket
• Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack
• Modern Tech: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data

Our offer:
• Ample opportunities to expand your knowledge and experience by working on a broad range of exciting projects, customers and technologies.
• Attractive prospects for career and personal development through training and coaching.
• A flat hierarchy and a culture of collaboration across all disciplines.
• A challenging and professional working environment in a dynamic international team with extensive expertise
• Exciting projects with latest technologies
• Fexible working hours, excellent team spirit and others benefits
• Good work-life balance (2 days per week from home)

🎯 What You Need:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field with >4 years of experience and minimun level B2 in English
• Solid experience in Java, Spring, Hibernate, and AWS.
• Curious mindset and a desire to learn.
• Embrace a DevOps approach.

Join us on our exciting journey, driving innovation with cutting-edge technologies. Let's shape the future together!

Elca is committed to create a diverse and inclusive work environment, and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or disability

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer Microservices
jobs_results.description:
GMV is an international leader in the area of #satellite control centers.

We are resizing our software teams and are looking for a profile with extensive experience in #microservices and #cloud architectures, with a background in #Java and #C++ for ambitious #space-sector projects.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

You will join a large software development team, which is betting on a technological transformation towards #microservices.

In an international environment with projects for the main international telecommunications satellite operators. It is required an intermediate level of English both written and spoken.

You will participate in the design of product updates, SW development, research of new solutions and evolution of our products, operational support to our clients...

The projects are stable and long term.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Experts and... passionate about software development and service-oriented architecture, looking for challenges and bring new knowledge and experience to complement the team.

You will join a consolidated software team with great domain of the industry and product with #SCRUM methodology.

Technologies:

#Java #C++, Load Balancing, #APIs (REST, WebSockets OpenAPI), Containers (#Docker, #Kubernetes), #API Gateways, #SpringBoot, Mysql, Architectures (#Redis), Ansible, GIT, #Jenkins/Bamboo.

React, #Python are valued.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Laura Uribarren, in charge of this vacancy.

Laura Uribarren

jobs_results.title: Senior C++ Developer
jobs_results.description:
Senior C++ Developer para empresa Tech enfocada a la IA

SOBRE LA EMPRESA

SW Inteligencia artificial.

Basan su tecnología avanzada en un motor revolucionario de IA que se adapta a las necesidades de cualquier situación que requiera precisión y fiabilidad.

ACERCA DE LA POSICIÓN

Posición C++ Developer: Senior C++ Developer.

Conocimientos técnicos de C y C++. Valorable conocimientos en Python.

Actualmente +15 personas en el equipo.

Proyecto en fase de expansión, necesitan un perfil Senior, de unos 4/5 años de experiencia.

CONOCIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS
• Posición: Programador Senior de C++
• Experiencia mínima requerida: 5 años
• Ambiente de programación: Esencialmente en Windows Conocimientos especializados
• Familiaridad con frameworks como PyTorch, TensorFlow, entre otros.
• Experiencia práctica con OpenCV.
• Competencia en el manejo de Nginx.

BENEFICIOS
• Salario hasta 45k
• Modalidad Híbrida de trabajo, 3 días en la oficina / 2 en casa
• Horario de 8h-17:30h
• Ubicados en... Badalona.
• Jornada Intensiva de 8-15h los viernes + Julio y agosto intensiva todos los días.
• Plan de Carrera Interno

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Age of Empires (Remote)
jobs_results.description:
Forgotten Empires is a full-service game developer focused on Windows PC games. While headquartered in the U.S., our team consists of 80+ passionate individuals from around the globe, each of whom brings a unique skill set and perspective to the table. Since 2022 we are part of Keywords Studios.

We are currently looking to add an experienced Software Engineer to work on Age of Empires. As a programmer with us, you will use your awesome skills in C++ to help us to bring our games to realization. In return, you will be part of a creative and supportive team environment with the ability to have a direct impact on the development of top-tier games.

Are you up for the challenge?

Some of the cool stuff you'll be doing:
• Working in a C++ codebase on a custom engine
• Generalist skillset, we're not looking for a specialized set of skills
• Maintain and develop features for the game and the tools that go with it
• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team on features
• Regularly debug... profile and optimize code

Requirements

What you'll bring to the table:
• Proven senior level engineer experience in C++
• Recent experience working in a video game industry
• Experience working in a team environment
• B2 English level - conversational and written
• Player/Development experience with RTS games is a plus (especially Age of Empires)
• You will be asked to partake in a technical test to prove your skills

Location: Must be local to Málaga, Spain or working remotely (EU time zones required)

Benefits

We offer competitive employment packages to suit your individual circumstances.

Forgotten Empires is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran's status, age or disability.

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

Keywords Studios is strongly committed to protecting your personal information. By sending your CV/Resume, you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and consent to your data being managed and retained in accordance with our data privacy and retention policy https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Studio: Forgotten Empires

Location: Europe, Spain, Malaga

Area of Work: Game Development

Service: Create

Employment Type: Full Time, Contractor

Working Pattern: Remote

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer Java (Cloud Solutions)
jobs_results.description:
Description

About Accedo

Accedo is a global video solutions provider, pioneering some of the world’s most impactful multi-screen experiences. We enable video businesses of all shapes and sizes to continuously grow, evolve, and innovate their offerings across regions, platforms, and devices. We leverage our long standing experience and focus on innovation to create premium and engaging video experiences.

Our team

Within Accedo, Global Solutions is a team of highly motivated experts with domain knowledge in PayTV/Broadcast, OTT, and Cloud. We're looking for a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join the Global Solutions function. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be part of a diverse and multi-disciplined team, leveraging cutting edge technologies and working with well recognized global brands. The role involves working in a highly collaborative environment, interacting and providing guidance and thought leadership to internal and external stakeholders, formulating and... implementing new solutions, driving the creation of prototypes, and further evolution of existing solutions.

About The Position

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who will strengthen our Global Solutions team and contribute towards accelerating the work on our cloud platform, which encompasses back-end services, systems, and infrastructure that power our cloud solutions.

Back-end services are primarily Java-based and cloud-native. We believe in a DevOps mindset, which for us means that we take full responsibility for developing and running the stack -- 'we build it and we run it'. You will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale, high availability back-end services, and own the platform infrastructure including managing cloud resources, build pipelines, and more. You will also be responsible for promoting a sound engineering culture through active technical leadership and hands-on development.

What We Are Looking For

For this particular role, we're looking for candidates who have extensive experience with Java and running services at scale, built on top of a Public Cloud (preferably AWS). You should also have:
• Deep knowledge of Java and Java-related technologies
• Experience building secure and reliable high-concurrency systems with very strict high-availability and low-latency requirements
• Experience building systems running on top of AWS and utilizing a variety of cloud resources
• Solid application performance tuning experience
• Strong system / service development experience
• Solid understanding of engineering methodologies, practices, and tools
• Experience with a wide variety of back-end technologies, databases, and architecture, including their benefits and trade-offs
• Experience integrating open source and 3rd party APIs and libraries
• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teammates
• Proven experience with live debugging and incident resolution

Does this sound like it's up your alley? Let's have a chat.

At Accedo, we are committed to fostering an environment of inclusiveness where employees are both valued and heard. Inclusion also means having diverse representation in gender, race, sex, thought, and other personal characteristics to contribute towards the betterment of our commerce and people. We strongly encourage applications from diverse communities to contribute towards our commitment of inclusivity

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador & Programador & I+D Senior
jobs_results.description: Desarrollador de aplicaciones web & programador & I+D de software de gestión empresarial Senior Desarrollador y programador senior Barcelona, Vigo y Orense Presentación EDISA Fundada en 1983, EDISA es una de las empresas líderes en España y Latinoamérica en el desarrollo e implementación de software de gestión empresarial ERP, siendo la empresa titular del software ERP LIBRA, que se encuentra implantado en aproximadamente 500 empresas en más de 30 países. Contamos con 6 sedes operativas en las principales ciudades de España y en 4 capitales de Latinoamérica. Además, en EDISA realizamos un importantísimo esfuerzo de I+D+I, lo que representa aproximadamente un 15% de nuestra facturación, manteniendo aproximadamente 40 proyectos de I+D abiertos de forma paralela. EDISA no solo desarrolla el software LIBRA, sino que también lleva a cabo su implantación y mantenimiento. Asimismo la empresa cuenta con otras áreas de trabajo, como todo lo relativo a los servicios Cloud y las herramientas de... Business Intelligence y Big Data. Desarrollador de aplicaciones web & programador & I+D de software de gestión empresarial con experiencia Buscamos incorporar para nuestras sedes de Barcelona, Vigo y Orense profesionales con experiencia demostrable en el área de la programación , para nuestro departamento de desarrollo e I+D de nuestro software LIBRA ERP . Buscamos personas que quieran desarrollar su carrera profesional junto a profesionales altamente cualificados en el mundo de la programación , de consultoría y de sistemas . Las funciones principales del puesto serán: Desarrollo/mantenimiento de aplicaciones/web. Análisis de aplicaciones. Participación en los proyectos de implantación del sistema ERP LIBRA. Con pasión por la informática, programación, robótica… Con ganas de trabajar en una empresa dinámica. Con interés y ganas de aprender, ya que la formación es continua. Que valore la estabilidad, ganas de quedarse en un puesto a largo plazo. Otras cualidades: que sea una persona trabajadora, confiable, resolutiva, práctica y proactiva. Competencias profesionales: Experiencia demostrable en programación (mínimo 3 años) Manejo de bases de datos Habilidades para el trabajo en equipo Requisitos deseables Desarrollo de aplicaciones en entorno de bases de datos Herramientas Oracle: Forms, BI Publisher Contrato indefinido a tiempo completo. Puesto en desarrollo de software de gestión en entorno Oracle, formando parte del equipo de desarrollo del ERP LIBRA. Salario negociable en función de la experiencia. Puesto de trabajo estable en una empresa multinacional en plena expansión. Formación a cargo de la empresa, en las herramientas y metodología de trabajo, así como en los conceptos propios del ámbito en el que se realizará la programación. Desarrollo de una carrera profesional personalizada junto a profesionales del máximo nivel de la consultoría e informática, que trabajan de manera ágil para ofrecer un software de calidad al ritmo deseado. Oportunidades para participar en proyectos y lanzamientos internacionales. Posibilidad de incorporación al equipo de I+D. Ambiente de trabajo excepcional, joven, dinámico y con metodologías Agile. Otras compensaciones: Flexibilidad horaria, adaptada a tus necesidades personales. Viernes tarde libres todo el año. Forma de trabajo principal: presencial Posibilidad de teletrabajo puntual para conciliar Programa de formación técnica interna continuada. Si quieres formar parte del equipo de EDISA rellena el siguiente formulario Nuestro equipo humano representa el activo más importante de nuestra empresa, con un índice de rotación sensiblemente inferior al habitual en nuestro mercado. Consiente que los datos personales que nos facilita serán tratados por EDISA para tramitar su solicitud. Si desea que le informemos de los productos y servicios que comercializa el EDISA, haga click. Puede ejercer sus derechos enviando un correo electrónico a ******. Si desea más información, vea el Aviso Legal #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Dashboards
jobs_results.description:
The Dashboards team builds, scales and operates high-performance, programmable, and beautiful user interfaces, where customers get to visualize and explore data about their systems. They solve complex and challenging issues around user experience. The team is responsible for UI, API and storage using React, Javascript, Python and Postgres.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:
• Own meaningful parts of our user interfaces, with an eye for performance and user experience
• Implement compelling, usable UIs, contribute to their design and engineer them with React
• Participate or lead architectural decisions for new and existing features
• Collaborate with experienced peers who will lift you up and be a mentor to other engineers on your... team
• Join a tightly knit team solving hard problems the right way

Who You Are:
• You have been building applications for 4+ years and know the systems you’ve worked on from top to bottom
• You have significant programming experience on the frontend (with a preference for the React environment)
• You have already made product decisions that shaped the day-to-day life of your users
• You want to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment that values diversity of talent, excellence of product, and exciting engineering challenges at scale

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:
• Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
• Continuous career development and pathing opportunities for internal mobility
• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds
• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
• Free global mental health benefit through Spring Health
• Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer (Developer Experience)
jobs_results.description:
At Preply, we are unlocking human potential through learning.

We believe learning with a great tutor is life-changing. That’s why we match online tutors from across the globe with learners and empower them to create live language classes with AI-powered tools and learning materials. This is how we deliver progress, create engagement and keep our global community of learners motivated. So far, over 32,000 tutors have given more than 15 million lessons to learners from over 175 countries.

Meet the team!

Part of the Platform Tribe, the Developer Experience team at Preply combines software development, infrastructure operations, and business skills to continuously improve and maintain state-of-the-art dev experience at Preply.

At Preply we believe that DevExp is crucial for the healthy growth of an engineering organization. Currently, we release our product 70-80 times a day with avg lead time for new features less than 24 hours. We impact the work of more than 100 product engineers... and have a noticeable impact on company performance.

DevExp Team Focus On 3 Main Areas
• Improving feedback loop (responsiveness and stability of stage environments, local development, etc)
• Decreasing cognitive load (Improving documentation practices, unifying dev practices, decreasing change failure rate)
• Improve flow state of engineers (minimizing distractions and increased autonomy of product teams)

We work in small teams, thus you will be able to influence system design and contribute a lot in the company's growth. We’re really serious about it: you’ll be able to actually measure how your work impacts business and present it to the whole company. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

We have diverse technical challenges (sometimes we write about them on our Engineering Blog) that will allow you to develop your skills across the stack. Please visit our Tech Radar and our YouTube channel to learn more about the technologies we use at Preply!

What You’ll Be Doing
• Gather metrics from the system and do surveys for engineers to identify key areas for improvement.
• Improve the lead time of Engineers at Preply.
• Developing internal developer platform.
• Improving architecture of core business applications.
• Improve practices of the pyramid of testing (unit test / integration / e2e).
• Frequently collaborate with product teams to understand key flaws of the system.
• Work with EKS and CI/CD to improve stability of dev tools.
• Introducing a process of continuous lib updates.
• Follow the best FinOps practices.
• Participate in on-call rotation for DevExp team.

What You Need To Succeed
• Expertise in problem solving and improving DevExp.
• Business-orientation and data-driven approach.
• Experience of web development with Python Django or Node.js React.
• Experience with AWS or any other cloud provider.
• Willingness to participate on paid on-call rotations.
• Strong communication skills. Minimum B2 English level.
• Track of record of improving developer experience would be a great plus.

Why you’ll love it at Preply
• An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
• A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
• A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
• Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub;
• Access to free mental health support platforms;
• Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
• The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

Our Principles
• Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
• We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
• Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
• Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
• Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
• Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
• Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
• Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
• Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
• One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive. Different opinions and viewpoints are key ingredients in our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company.

Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status. Together, we are The World Class

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Avature's highly configurable, high-performance platform has been redefining the large-enterprise SaaS market since 2005, resulting in an exciting work environment full of technical challenges and learning opportunities with a team that never stops growing.

Our Senior Software Engineers work in small development teams that act like mini software companies, balancing refactoring and new feature development, defining and presenting road maps quarterly, and fully participating in the fundamental aspects of the commercial software business, from maintainability and usability to competitive positioning. If you are passionate about working in high-powered teams building out the complex components and services of a powerful multi-application SaaS platform and want to use your analytical and technical skills to tackle complex engineering challenges, Avature could be the place for you.

Your Challenges And Objectives
• Achieve expert-level knowledge of our platform by understanding the... complex interaction of a wide range of services and feature sets, from framework layer to end user experience.
• Incorporate into your work product several computer science disciplines, such as high availability and high performance system design, industry-leading security standards, and intuitive user interface design.
• Abstract customer feature requests in order to build a highly flexible platform which allows users to customize it through tailored configurations and UI options.
• Learn and collaborate with different teams while tackling complex technical challenges in a fun and encouraging working environment.

Your Day-to-day Activities
• Work with the product team on functional specifications of features (specs): interpret, analyze, and provide feedback.
• Design and write the code for the feature.
• Perform technical analysis of existing code and refactors to improve code quality.
• Review code from your peers in different teams.
• Promote and apply best practices during the entire development process, from the very early stages of technical analysis and design of solutions to the monitoring in production of your team’s code.

About You

Minimum Qualifications:
• Work experience in software development
• Analytical/troubleshooting skills
• Strong background in OOP, SOLID principles, DDD, and unit testing
• Fluency in one or more of the following: PHP, JavaScript, Java, C++, Python
• Working knowledge of Unix, preferably Linux

About Us

Avature is a market leading enterprise SaaS Solution provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the very large company market. We currently work with over 650 companies worldwide, including 110 of the Fortune 500, all of the Big Four consulting firms, the largest banks and manufacturers in the world, and five governments.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With 26 releases a year and a strong commitment to innovation and quality engineering, our private cloud platform has become the product choice for the very large global organization.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We offer a career development program that supports continuous learning and thoughtful leadership, and that meaningfully impacts each individual’s professional trajectory.

What We Offer
• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.
• Flexible hours.
• Work remotely or come by the office as much as you want.
• Competitive salary, with one review a year.
• Sanitas health coverage.
• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.
• End of year week off (December 26 to 31).
• Paid internet service expenses.
• Birthdays off.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - FoundationDB
jobs_results.description:
We're on a mission to build the best platform for our engineers to deliver stateful services at high scale. We provide High Performance Transaction Systems to all the Datadog developers, we empower them with solutions which focus on simplicity, reliability, durability, and availability.

We operate services and databases in a scalable and cost-efficient way, evolving in a high-volume, low-latency environment that is continuing to double in size.

We value pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:
• Design, build and maintain the infrastructure we need to support orders of magnitude more customers, while minimizing issues and controlling cost
• Investigate and fix... issues or bottlenecks, whether it’s deep in the platform code or in the client application
• Support the services and datastores that we own, 24x7
• Build tooling and automation to run our infrastructure with minimal human intervention
• Work with developers to design data models and advise on datastores options

Who You Are:
• You have a BS/MS/PhD in a Computer Science, Engineering or related scientific field or at least 5 years of professional experience
• You have production experience with distributed systems, e.g. Zookeeper, Cassandra, Postgres, FoundationDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis, MongoDB
• You are mastering at least one programming or scripting language, e.g. Go, Java, Rust, C/ C++
• You want to work in a fast, high-growth startup environment that respects its engineers and customers
• You can design simple and performant architecture to solve problems at high scale
• Bonus Point: You have hands-on engineering experience with at least one of the major cloud providers – AWS, Azure, GCP

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:
• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
• Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions
• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+
• Competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.
